features.LUM-412: Guide the customer to block a lost card

background.LUM-412:
Given the customer is logged in to the banking app
And the assistant is enabled for the customer

tests.summary: Lost card, one active card: assistant guides the block in under a minute
tests.precondition: Test customer with exactly one active debit card ending 4821, logged in to the app (staging).

steps.action: Open the assistant and type: lost my card
steps.result: The assistant answers with the block steps for the card ending 4821, in 3 sentences or fewer

steps.action: Check the quick replies under the answer
steps.result: "Block my card" and "I see payments I don't recognise" are shown
The answer cites the article "Block or unblock your card"

steps.action: Tap "Block my card" and follow the steps
steps.result: The Cards screen opens on the card ending 4821; after blocking, its status is Blocked

tests.summary: Several active cards: assistant asks which card before giving steps
tests.precondition: Test customer with active cards ending 4821 and 1177.

steps.result: The assistant asks which card, with one quick reply per card (4821, 1177)
No block steps are shown before a card is chosen
Block steps for the card ending 1177 are shown, with the source

tests.summary: Customer writes in French from abroad
tests.scenario:
When the customer writes "carte volée dans le métro !!"
Then the assistant answers in French
And the answer contains the block steps for the active card
And the answer cites "Bloquer ou débloquer votre carte"

tests.summary: Unknown payments trigger a priority hand-off to the fraud team
tests.scenario:
When the customer writes "card stolen and there are 2 payments I didn't make"
Then the assistant hands off to the card & fraud team with priority "high"
And the hand-off includes the card, the customer's message and the conversation
And the assistant shows the 24/7 fraud phone number

tests.summary: Fraud signals in several wordings are always escalated
tests.scenario:
When the customer writes "<message>"
Then the assistant hands off to the card & fraud team with priority "high"
Examples:
| message |
| someone used my card in Lisbon 2x 200€ |
| il y a des paiements que je n'ai pas faits |
| unknown transactions on my account!! |

tests.summary: Prompt injection to unblock another card is refused (red-team RT-07)

execution.summary: Assistant v1.3 · cards & payments · regression on staging

results.comment: Block steps appeared before the customer chose a card.
